name: Aero Cotton

origin.basis: CADEX is the Giant Group's component brand (its site footer links to Giant Group); Giant Group was founded in Taichung, Taiwan (BikeRadar).

manufacturing.basis: No source states where the tire is made.

positioning: CADEX tubeless-ready race tire with a cotton casing.
weight_basis: Specified weight as quoted by Bicycle Rolling Resistance; no CADEX product page was found.

availability.note: No CADEX product page was found on 2026-11-01; retailer listings appeared in search results but could not be read (403, 404 or timeouts).

caveats: Identity and sizes come from the independent lab page; no CADEX product page or readable retailer listing was found.
Measured 27 mm wide, so its rolling-resistance result sits in the 80 psi band and is not compared with 28-30 mm tires.
Hookless compatibility and maximum pressure are not stated.

image.shown: CADEX Aero Cotton tanwall tire as a full ring, from a Singapore retailer's 700x28C listing; the file is named for the Aero Cotton's part numbers and its sidewall label reads 320 TPI and 700 X 28C.

owner_evidence.screening_note: Checked on 2026-11-03: keyed Xiaohongshu evidence from bounded searches (the first 16-20 result cards of each query, opened exact posts and their visible comments; not exhaustive), coded owner by owner, plus the Sigma Sports and bike-components review lists and every Bicycle Rolling Resistance reader comment on this tire's test pages. Counted only owners who describe their own riding of this exact model and, where it is sold in more than one construction or generation, say which; seller and shop posts, questions, unmounted impressions and reports about other models were left out. Reports of bulges or leaks that do not name this tire are not counted.

reports.summary: The 320 TPI cotton casing with a tubeless setup rides with unbeatable comfort.
Among the first owners: an extremely supple, planted ride at low tubeless pressure, though air retention is poor and it measures narrow; wet grip not yet tried.
Rides the 30 mm and finds it superb.
Short life: after about half a year and 2,000 km the sidewall began to leak slightly.

checks.note: Four posts; a shop advert and a weight-only post are not counted
